rule.rate: share of available replicates with p <= alpha
rule.gain: nuisance column, top effect: rate_arm - rate_baseline > gain_se_multiplier * pooled SE
rule.protected: nuisance column, top effect: rate_baseline - rate_arm <= loss_se_multiplier * pooled SE
rule.no_loss: clean column, every effect: rate_baseline - rate_arm <= loss_se_multiplier * pooled SE
rule.controls: both columns: rate_arm <= alpha + k * sqrt(alpha * (1 - alpha) / R)

baseline_role: measured, not judged (covariates in the trajectory model only, covariate-blind basis)
